answer: Neighborhood persistence requirement: each agent must maintain a slowly-decaying neighbor history with distinct counterparties across epochs. New identities start at the fable stage, unable to reach transaction zenith until their neighborhood graph reaches a minimum distinct-degree threshold, and fall to nadir if counterparties drop below it. An attacker must build many genuine distinct connections per identity, since reuse links them into one cluster that counts once. Cost: O(k) real relationships per sybil.
